name: WorldReward-Bench
summary: 对相同图像和相机轨迹生成的视频对进行人类偏好评测。
summaryEn: Human preference evaluation of video pairs generated from the same image and camera trajectory.
scaleZh: 760 对视频；9 个世界模型
access: Official documentation provides data access instructions; download not tested
accessZh: 官方文档提供数据访问说明；未实测下载
license: Consult publisher terms; data license not independently verified
licenseZh: 请核对发布方条款；数据许可尚未独立核实
wmNote: 动作指相机运动，不是机器人电机控制；奖励模型本身不另算数据集。
wmNoteEn: Actions denote camera motion, not robot motor control; the reward model itself is not a separate dataset.

evidence.statement: The benchmark releases paired videos sharing an initial image and commanded camera trajectory, with human verdicts on action consistency, appearance and motion quality. It specifically evaluates camera-conditioned world models.
